name: findmyvybe-moderation-service
description: Phase-1 microservice extraction from the findmyvybe-app monolith: ONLY the ML inference step of photo moderation (nsfwjs nudity classification + face-api face counting). It has no database of its own and makes no policy decisions -- it takes an image, returns raw signals, and the main app's lib/safety/policyEngine.ts still decides APPROVED/REJECTED/MANUAL_REVIEW and still owns the Photo/ModerationCase rows. See ../docs/MODERATION_SERVICE.md for the full extraction writeup and deployment steps.
